posts.text:
The newest fossil fuel disinformation craze is that solar panels constantly leach pollutants and make the soil underneath them permanently infertile so therefore no landowner/farmer should install them on their property.

Meanwhile, agrivoltaics projects are currently disproving that disinformation:
The only Data center I'm down with.

Supporting solid waste infrastructure like this convenience center used to be a major part of my job when I was an environmental planner for the state, so I understand better than most what a big deal this is. Kudos to everyone involved who made this rebuild possible!

Recovering from a climate disaster takes time, and it's important to celebrate all the little progress along the way — which is why I'm quite excited that the closest solid waste convenience center to my house has officially reopened for the first time since it was destroyed by Hurricane Helene.

So many believe that addressing deforestation isn’t possible, but Costa Rica is proving it can be done — even under our current economic system that prioritizes exploitation of nature.

The country enacted payments for ecosystem services a few decades ago, and so far, they’ve been successful!
I officially had to call it quits on Threads. It was really messing with my mental health, and I firmly believe that’s by design!
Source: www.pv-magazine.com/2026/04/28/i...

Ireland recently surpassed 1 GW of installed grid-scale solar capacity — which is enough to power around 500,000 homes.

Let's hope these installations will help address the energy crisis there that has been made worse by the war with Iran!
GOOD NEWS: 59 countries have agreed to develop national roadmaps for phasing out fossil fuels after attending the first ever conference aimed at phasing out fossil fuels in Santa Marta, Colombia.
Most of the climate articles from the BBC that I need to read for work are now behind a paywall for Americans!
I wish I knew who started the rumor. It’s taken off like wildfire on TikTok, and anyone who tries to refute it is immediately attacked.

I can only offer anecdotal evidence, but the one time I tried to refute the misinformation that data centers are the largest users of water globally, thousands of users unfollowed me and strangers sent me threats of violence because they thought I was pro-AI.

The UAE quitting OPEC was truly not on my 2026 bucket list considering dozens of UAE-backed bot accounts threatened to doxx me when I kept calling out the hypocrisy of the UAE hosting COP back in 2023..
People say that "individual actions" like changing your lightbulbs don't matter, but that right there is a lot of destroyed demand!

I don’t have the time right now to produce a deep dive about AMOC, but thankfully the folks over at @carbonbrief.org did!

So if you’ve been freaking out about a potential AMOC collapse, read this because it’s not as likely as the media/social media is making it out to be.

What better way to end Earth Week than with some #GoodClimateNews?

Read more: goodclimatenews.substack.com/p/edition-41...
Happy #EarthDay y’all 🫶
Are you going to pay for the income I would lose by deleting those platforms? I don't think so because Instagram is my main platform, and paid partnerships I post there account for 80% of my income.

We’ve still got to take action to prevent further damage from his administration, but isn’t it wild that he’s helping other countries commit more to climate action? 

(Folks on Facebook are already sending me threats because of this video, so that means I must be doing something right!)
In a first last month, renewables supplied more power to the U.S. than natural gas, a milestone in the shift to clean energy.
Reversing deforestation is absolutely possible. Just ask Costa Rica 🇨🇷
